sources.snippet: 1. Load base model with Unsloth Unsloth bundles patched 4-bit kernels — that's how Qwen2.5-3B (or 7B) stays in T4 / A100 budget. The FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained call returns a 4-bit quantized base; get_peft_model attaches the LoRA adapter on top.
